title: PlatformSelfDescription
description: A machine-readable self-description of a W3DS post-platform, stored on the platform's own eVault.

id.description: Body id (mirrors the metaEnvelope id on the canonical)

platformName.description: The join key other platforms match on, case-insensitively — never a repo, domain or product name

displayName.description: Platform name as people see it

content.description: The self-description itself: what the platform writes, under which ontologies, and how to read it

contentSha256.description: SHA-256 of `content`, lowercase hex, so a reader can tell the text changed

sourceUrl.description: Where the same text is published outside the vault, when it is

profileEnvelopeId.description: metaEnvelope id of the platform's own profile record

createdAt.description: When the self-description was first written
